messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: hosted-runtime kv-cache memory spike -> OOMs detected on cluster-hosted-03 (severity: P1). Error rate increased 12x in last 3m. Auto-scaling attempted and partially failed. Paging now.

evan_sre: ack. I'm taking pager. any obvious client?

maria_runtime: seeing large growth in kv-map size from sessions with very long prompts. looks like prefetch depth jumped recently for that route (service: text-gen/long-context).

ev an_sre: confirm which change bumped prefetch? any recent rollout?

alex_eng: fwiw we merged a batching/prefetch tuning change 2h ago: default prefetch_depth went from 8 -> 32 for experimentation. PR 4032.

june_support: Customer Brown on hosted tier reported timeouts ~2:03pm and chat truncation. They sent sample traces. tagging @cust-brown for visibility.

cust-brown: saw massive slowdowns then failures, sessions dropped. happy to share logs.

evan_sre: ok root cause hypothesis: prefetch depth increase + some users sending >100k token prompts -> kv cache keeps growing and continuous batching aggregates many sessions -> memory blowup. we need live mitigation to stop further OOMs.

maria_runtime: agreed. immediate mitigations: 1) lower prefetch_depth back to 6 for hosted-runtime cluster-hosted-03 2) limit continuous_batching_max_tokens to 2048 for the route 3) enable aggressive eviction for kv-cache (evict_threshold=0.6).

alex_eng: can push a config override without full deploy? I can update runtime flags in the control plane for that cluster.

ev an_sre: please do it, prioritize throttling prefetch. Also put a temporary quota for per-session context length to 30k tokens for hosted tier until we stabilize.

alex_eng: doing the override now. running: 
```
# curl to control plane
curl -X POST https://controlplane.redwood.internal/api/v1/runtime/config/cluster-hosted-03/override \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"prefetch_depth":6, "continuous_batching_max_tokens":2048, "kv_eviction_threshold":0.6}'
```

ops-bot: deploy-job/override-config-5219876543 started by alex_eng. job_id=dj-9832.

ops-bot: deploy-job/override-config-5219876543 succeeded. change_id=chg-7192.

maria_runtime: flags applied. I'm dropping the per-session quota now: 
```
# set session limit
redwoodctl clusters update hosted-03 --session-token-limit 30000
```

june_support: I've messaged Customer Brown about mitigation and asked for sample payloads. told them we're throttling prefetch and will follow up.

evan_sre: monitoring memory. initial heap/mem usage on host group decreased ~45% after override. no new OOMs in last 2m. CPU spikes remain but transient.

ryan_product: any customer visible regressions from lowering prefetch? latency impact?

maria_runtime: expect some latency increase for very long prompts because we'll fetch more on-demand, but overall stable. this is better than OOMs.

alex_eng: I also rolled back the experimental PR (4032) on the control plane routing config for hosted tenants. rollback completed.

ops-bot: rollback-job/4032 completed.

cust-brown: thanks — service is back for us. we'll send a few sanitized traces in case you want to replay.

evan_sre: great. next steps: 1) keep prefetch_depth at 6 for 24h on hosted-03 2) run a narrower rollout of PR4032 with prefetch_depth capped to 12 and a guard that prevents sessions >40k tokens from using high-prefetch route 3) add alerting to detect kv-map growth per-session (new metric: kv_map_size_p95) 4) postmortem and customer comms draft.

maria_runtime: I'll open the hotfix PR to enforce continuous_batching_max_tokens at the orchestration layer and add eviction metrics. linking now. PR 4051.

alex_eng: monitoring dashboards: memory-cluster-hosted-03 now at safe levels. no new OOMs for 10m.

evan_sre: I'll keep the pager until we hit 30m stable. moving to incident-handoff in 20m to follow up on root cause and long-term fix.

june_support: I'll draft a brief email to affected customers summarizing actions and ETA for full postmortem. sharing with @ryan_product for review.

ryan_product: ack — review incoming. focus note: explain experimental change and why we reverted. apologize, offer extended logs access.

maria_runtime: for postmortem: hypothesis is unguarded prefetch increase interacted badly with small number of heavy long-context sessions + continuous batching aggregation. long-term fix options: adaptive prefetch based on session length, per-session kv quotas, and backpressure when kv_map growth rate exceeds X per minute.

evan_sre: documenting timeline and will include config diffs. tagging for follow-up: @maria_runtime, @alex_eng, @june_support, @ryan_product.

ops-bot: incident-note: incident 2026-05-12-5219876543 created. severity=P1. assigned=evan_sre.

evan_sre: closing active pager handoff: handing to oncall-sre-forensics for postmortem. I'll keep monitoring.

maria_runtime: quick reminder — add a test to the rollout pipeline that injects a long prompt traffic pattern so we prevent similar regressions.

alex_eng: noted. I'll add a gating test and re-run canary with synthetic long-context load.

june_support: customer Brown asked for a short timeline — I'll send a follow-up now saying we expect a full postmortem within 48 hours.

cust-brown: appreciated. thanks for fast response.
